MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 13

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 4

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
